params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Write-Output ('PWD=' + (Get-Location).Path); Get-ChildItem -Path $HOME -Directory -Force | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; Get-ChildItem -Path $HOME -Directory -Recurse -Depth 3 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName '.git') } | Select-Object -First 20 -ExpandProperty FullName
